title: Kamishiro Rui — Wonderlands×Showtime〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There's nothing else to do here. I'll just go home.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hmm? Is that Nene singing?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She's practicing in front of Robo-Nene?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad that she's now comfortable performing on stage in person but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She always brings Robo-Nene with her, both to our rehearsals and shows. It seems she needs her for reassurance.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you enjoyed my song!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm no longer afraid of performing on stage, but that's only thanks to you, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Without you next to me, I lose confidence again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just as I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't leave it like this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm, this explains a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that's why you kept bringing Robo-Nene here, even though she's already served her original purpose.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eek!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I... I thought you'd gone home...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I do apologize for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm pleased you've been taking such good care of Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's already accomplished the mission I had set out for her when I built her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it seems it's too early to retire her.
She's still needed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a proposition. You would have to let me take her from you for a short while, though. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What are you planning to do?
Are you going to modify her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not quite.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm just going to tweak her a little so that she'll serve you better... Serve us all better, as a member of our troupe and a wonderful addition to our shows.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean... You'll make it so that she can perform together with us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
If that is what you want.
Is it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I'll happily take care of her for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How do you envision her role in our shows?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd like her to be able to do all sorts of different things together with us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And have her perform without me having to remotely control her every action.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case...
I'll have to make her partly autonomous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll install an AI.
She'll be able to talk a little.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She would of course need facial and voice recognition software as well. Hmm, I'll have to expand her memory.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems I've got my work cut out for me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You look happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am. I have all these exciting ideas hatching in my head.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I can't wait to test them out...
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're not going to make her into a giant robot, or give her transformation abilities, are you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait and you'll see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But remember I won't like it if you add any weird functions to her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Heh, I won't. All new features will be designed specifically to make you and our audience happy!
